text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate Twenty Third Street, between Lake Shore Boulevard West and Alder Crescent/Twenty Second Street, as one-way southbound, which will address operational concerns due to the roadway width of this section of Twenty Third Street.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing one-way street designation, on Twenty Third Street from Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 7.5 metres south, as one-way for southbound traffic only, to be in effect between Lake Shore Boulevard West and Alder Crescent/Twenty Second Street.
